title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with asset edit permission could change the approval requirements and…
description: In Splunk SOAR versions prior to 8.8.0, users with asset edit permissions can modify approval requirements and the effective automation user for an asset without these changes being recorded in field-level audit logs. This lack of audit coverage reduces accountability and weakens investigation capabilities for changes made to security-sensitive asset settings.
